name: Adessa Mind
line: The clinic system behind the Adessa Quotient.
summary: Adessa Mind gives clients a score for how their mind is working today, from a single clinic visit. We built the platform that runs that visit from check-in to the plan they leave with. Every number traces back to its source.
includes: In-clinic tests, data import, scoring, client reports, AI assistant, staff console
system: Clients, sessions, team roles and billing in one place, with every change on record.
Turns test results and health data into one score a client can understand.
Short timed tasks clients take on a screen during the visit.
Reads results from the clinic's existing devices, so nobody types them in by hand.
An AI assistant that knows the clinic's own material and drafts client reports for staff to check.
Step-by-step guides so anyone on the team can run a visit.
note: The AQ is a non-diagnostic measure of current cognitive state, for informational and wellness purposes only.

name: Art of Practice
line: The operating system for the solo clinical professional.
summary: Solo clinical professionals pay for a stack of apps and still can't answer a simple question: am I making money? We designed and built Art of Practice, one platform for the schedule, notes, client files, payments and credentials, plus the investor overview and product demo.
includes: Today view, charting, AI-assisted notes, practice reports, professional vault, investor overview
system: Revenue, schedule, open notes, unpaid invoices and license renewals on one screen.
Note templates, consent forms and client records, private by design.
Speak the findings, then review a structured note before it's saved.
One financial picture across every place the practitioner works.
Licenses, credentials and continuing education, with renewal reminders.
The story, the product and the plan in twelve slides, with a recorded demo.
run: turned dictated findings into a note
updated this month's income and expenses
results: platform instead of a stack of apps

name: Element Glo
line: One platform to sell, market and service a glow pool brand.
summary: Element Glo makes pool finishes that glow after dark, but the business ran on phone calls, PDFs and inboxes. We built a site and store that sell the product, an AI guide that answers questions at any hour, a portal that runs sales and marketing, and free design tools that make glow an easy yes for pool builders.
built: Site, store, AI guide, portal + design tools
includes: Online store, Aggro the AI guide, staff portal, Element Glo Studio, UV light planner
facts: Site, store, AI guide, portal + design tools
system: A dark, cinematic site built around the night glow, with real projects and a mosaic catalog that flips between day and night.
Aggregates and mosaics sell online with live shipping, automatic tax, trade pricing and a quantity calculator. Big orders go to a person.
An AI guide trained on Element Glo's content. He answers product and install questions any time and hands people to the team when they want a person.
Visitors, marketing and sales in one place. Every form, chat and estimate lands as a contact with the full email thread.
Free design tools for builders and dealers: a pool visualizer, a mosaic layout planner, a display wall planner and branded quotes.
Upload a pool plan, trace the pool, and get light placement, aggregate amounts, photoreal previews and a branded report.
run: read the pool plan and specs
builder traced pool, stairs and spa
placed UV lights for full coverage
sent branded PDF to the builder

name: Fit Funnels
line: Client launches for a fitness marketing team, on rails.
summary: Each new gym client meant a week of setup and a checklist nobody could find. We turned launch into a written system and built agents for onboarding, pre-launch checks and the weekly report.
includes: Onboarding, launch QA and reporting agents
before: Onboarding calls repeat the same questions
Weekly reports built by hand on Friday
system: One written process for taking a new gym client from signed to live.
Sends the intake form and asset request and chases anything missing.
Checks pages, forms and tracking before anything goes live.
Builds the weekly client report from campaign data.
run: sent intake form and asset request

name: Jason Stephenson
line: Publishing and inbox ops for a meditation creator.
summary: A large audience means a steady stream of releases, messages and licensing requests. We wrote down the release pipeline and built agents that prep each drop, sort the inbox and route licensing requests to the right person.
before: Every release prepped by hand per platform
Fans, partners and spam share one inbox
system: Every step of a release, from final audio to scheduled posts, in one place.
Preps titles, descriptions and tags and queues each release across channels.
Sorts messages into fans, partners and everything else.
Routes licensing requests with standard terms to the right person.

name: MaWa!
line: Launch ops for a matcha water brand.
summary: A beverage launch runs on store outreach, orders and investor updates at the same time. We built the launch system and agents that work the retail pipeline, reconcile orders and draft the monthly update.
includes: Retail, orders and investor update agents
system: The weekly rhythm for retail outreach, orders and investor updates.
Tracks the store pipeline and follows up with open accounts.
Reconciles orders and payouts as they come in.
Drafts the monthly update from the month's numbers and notes.
